checks.where: Cottage C ridge piece (3.50 m free; its role timber.beam allows 2.5 m)
checks.text: 1 part(s) has a free span longer than its role allows.
checks.fix: add a support under the long span. Each role has its own limit (timber.floor and timber.plank 1.38 m, timber.beam and timber.fence 2.5 m, judged, in place-kit/data/roles.json). A real longer span (a hall's tie beam between its walls, a gallery bay of 3 m) is allowed when the place's own facts file holds a "free_span" fact for it with a source, for example {"id": "hall_tie_beam_span", "applies_to_role": "^timber\\.beam$", "applies_to_name": "tie beam", "dimension": "free_span", "max": 7.5, "unit": "metres", "kind": "judged", "source": "WHERE THE SIZE COMES FROM", "confidence": "good"}, and the audit is judged with --facts

checks.text: 165 size(s) fit the real-world facts
0% plain boxes (at most 15%)
no role has most of its objects as exact copies
2 road(s) have real relief and ruts

making the masks took 151 s (budget 120 s).
owner unowned: 2,723,900 triangles (at most 1,500,000).
checks.fix: thin out the scatter or simplify meshes; a card draws about 1.5 million triangles per builder comfortably.

checks.text: the scene has light
renderer EEVEE: nothing is lit: no lamp but the sun, no glowing material, no glow object (EEVEE is fine when the lights are off)
not marked for the film ("for_film" is not true in place-settings.json): any frame shape is allowed
4 view camera(s): no empty sky below the horizon, every clip end reaches the farthest object, nothing far casts shadows (3 backdrop object(s))
no view has more than 50% of the ground it sees shadowed from the sun "Sun" (50 degrees up)
the wear layers' shade used the scene's sun lamp "Sun" (compass 315, 50 degrees up)
no sign, notice, placard, poster, name board or book in the place
the audit was made with this exact settings file (place-settings.json)

place_audit.world.unit: metres from the nearest view camera, metres across, share of a view's rays that go below the horizon and hit nothing, metres across (the widest horizontal extent of the visible objects that are not backdrop)

place_audit.sun.unit: share of the ground points a view sees that are shadowed from the sun; degrees between the sun the wear layers' shade used and the scene's sun lamp
